```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(CCAflow)
```

High-dimensional or ill-conditioned blocks should not be handled by maximizing unregularized sample correlation alone.

```{r}
d <- cca_simulate(n=80, p=35, q=30, scenario="collinear", seed=4)
ridge <- cca_ridge(d$X,d$Y,lambda_x=.2,lambda_y=.2,ncomp=2)
sparse <- cca_sparse(d$X,d$Y,ncomp=2,penalty_x=.1,penalty_y=.1,engine="internal")
cv <- cca_validate(d$X,d$Y,"ridge",list(lambda_x=.2,lambda_y=.2,ncomp=2),folds=5,repeats=2,seed=4)
```

When contamination is scientifically plausible, compare rather than silently delete observations.

```{r}
o <- cca_simulate(n=100,scenario="outliers",seed=5)
cmp <- cca_robust_compare(o$X,o$Y,robust_engine="winsor")
```
